html: Executable schemas for all sixteen entity types (v0.1 had three), with the field tables in the specification generated from them. The extension mechanism is implemented: namespace syntax, object shape and the recursive named-key restrictions are checked without a profile, and a supplied profile is validated and reported with its version and envelope hash. A checker for a supplied bundle of records applies ten named cross-record rules and reports every finding at a JSON pointer, with a written guide to what it does and does not establish. Privacy classes are carried from v0.1 for the fields that existed there; a nested field without its own class shows its parent's class and says so, and a field with no assignment reads as not separately assigned rather than open. Three code lists are added for the new entity types (the benefit layer, the HSE Management Standards domains and the release category), so the registry holds 27 versioned lists where it held 24; the README and llms.txt say so. The v0.1 draft stays published at its own address. The download is owhs-v0.2-bundle.zip. Corrected in the carried tables: the ReasonableAdjustment end-date anchor said a null meant a standing adjustment; the schema forbids null, so the anchor now says to omit the field when no end date is recorded and to use the status field for adjustment state. The AggregateReport description no longer opens by calling the report the only way individual-level results leave an organisation; it names employer-visible aggregate results and their suppression declarations, with no validation keyword changed.
